income.title: {{adjective}} Income
income.emptyDescription: Revenue sources, fiscal autonomy, and national tax dependency.
income.description: The Bureau of Local Government Finance's Annual Regular Income and Dependencies for {{lgu}}: where its regular income comes from, and how much of it is raised locally.
income.annualRevenue: As stated by BLGF for the fiscal year
income.lsrShare: Share of annual regular income raised locally
income.allotmentShare: Share of annual regular income from the allotment
income.definition: BLGF defines annual regular income as locally sourced revenue (real property tax for the general fund, tax on business, other taxes, regulatory fees, service charges and receipts from economic enterprises) plus the allotment, other shares from national tax collections and interest income. Each dependency is BLGF's own ratio of that source to annual regular income.
